name: Domony (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of blue and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Domony (a blue shield with a yellow monogram, within a green wreath) above a scroll inscribed DOMONY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Domony arms with wreath and scroll
